meta.title: Water Together | Martí Sabaté
meta.description: A platformer about merging and splitting water drops, made for Brackeys Game Jam 2021.1.

content.title: Water Together
about: Water Together is a short platformer built around a simple rule: merge with other water drops to become bigger, stronger, and faster, so you can reach new areas.
You can also split to control multiple drops and solve traversal challenges.
features: Core merge mechanic that changes player size and abilities
Split mechanic to control multiple drops for puzzles and traversal
Short, self-contained level progression aimed at jam scope
learnings: Designing a mechanic that directly drives level layout
Scope control and polish under jam constraints
Communicating game rules clearly to the player
